in_marathi.name: Budhan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Budhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Budhan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Budh', meaning wisdom or intelligence. In Hindu mythology, Budhan is the planet Mercury, and the deity associated with knowledge, intelligence, and communication. This name is considered auspicious for a child who is expected to grow up to be wise, intelligent, and knowledgeable.
